title: reforma-al-dia
desc: The morning the DOF publishes a reform, an AI agent applies it to the law and opens a PR for review. 90.7% of articles exact in 34 real decrees.

title: leyes-mx
desc: Mexican federal statutes as versioned Markdown. Every reform is a commit, so you can git log, blame and diff the law.

title: mcp-leyes
desc: Lets Claude read Mexican federal law at any date: exact article text, reform history and word-level diffs over git.

title: mcp-dof
desc: Lets Claude read Mexico's Official Gazette (DOF): any day's edition, the full text of every decree, title search and the daily FIX, UDIS and TIIE.

title: constitucion-viva
desc: Mexico's 1917 Constitution, alive: 285 reform decrees article by article, word-level diffs and the citation web of 36 laws.

title: radar-energia
desc: Mexico's energy sector every morning: DOF, CNE, SENER, ASEA and CENACE items, power and fuel prices, each with its source.

title: modelos-al-dia
desc: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok compared and kept current: models, API prices, app plans, 12 coding agents and official release notes.

title: indicadores-mx
desc: Mexico's official indicators (FIX, UDIS, TIIE, INPC, minimum wage, UMA): 37,372 values, each linked to its DOF note, as JSON and CSV.

title: dof-diario
desc: The Official Gazette's table of contents since January 2025 (43,994 notes), refreshed twice a day by GitHub Actions, with a searchable site.

title: hoy-circulo
desc: Can I drive today? Mexico City's no-drive rules, emissions check windows and live smog alerts, in an offline app with a calendar export.

title: aumento-renta
desc: How much can your rent go up? Updates it with Mexico's INPC or UDIS, cites every official value and checks Mexico City's legal cap.

title: pension-imss
desc: How much will my IMSS pension be? Ley 73 and Ley 97, every step with its article and the Supreme Court criteria.

title: finiquito-mx
desc: Severance under Mexico's Federal Labor Law, computed line by line, with the article behind every peso. Library plus web app.

title: facturas-cfdi
desc: Drop your CFDI invoices and see your spending and possible personal tax deductions, computed in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

title: mis-laboratorios
desc: Chart your lab results over the years against each lab's range, read from your PDFs in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

title: segundo-cerebro
desc: A ready-to-install second brain for Claude Code: an Obsidian vault with dashboards, a daily log and a weekly review that Claude keeps current.

title: tema-clawds
desc: A light theme for the Claude Code app with 64 tiny Clawds playing in 20 scenes, generated as SVG from a script.

title: portafolio-ia
desc: What I have built with AI in 2026: legal RAG, n8n automations, data pipelines, a product on sale, websites and video. Live at pivotek.mx.
